commission.image_prompt: A warm golden-brown sourdough loaf, crusty and inviting, sitting on a simple dark wooden table. Behind it, a soft afternoon light filters through a window with a hint of Porto’s terracotta rooftops visible in the distance. The background is softly blurred, focusing attention on the bread. No text, no logos, no letters.
commission.svg_brief: A central golden-brown sourdough loaf icon, slightly textured, with a clean shadow beneath it. The background is a gradient from warm terracotta (#8B4513) at the bottom to soft cream (#D2B48C) at the top. Minimal, bold, and modern.

svg.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Background Gradient -->
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGradient" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8B4513" />
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#D2B48C" />
    </linearGradient>
    
    <!-- Loaf Shadow Filter -->
    <filter id="loafShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="5" dy="10" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="rgba(0,0,0,0.3)" />
    </filter>
    
    <!-- Loaf Texture Pattern -->
    <pattern id="loafTexture" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" width="20" height="20">
      <path d="M0,10 Q5,5 10,10 T20,10" stroke="#556B2F" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" opacity="0.3" />
      <path d="M0,15 Q5,10 10,15 T20,15" stroke="#556B2F" stroke-width="0.5" fill="none" opacity="0.3" />
    </pattern>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="600" height="800" fill="url(#bgGradient)" />

  <!-- Headline -->
  <text x="300" y="200" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="48" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2F4F4F">Porto Bakes Free</text>

  <!-- Loaf Icon -->
  <g transform="translate(250, 300)" filter="url(#loafShadow)">
    <!-- Loaf Body -->
    <path d="M200,150 C220,100 280,100 300,150 L320,200 C340,250 340,300 300,350 C280,370 220,370 200,350 L180,300 C140,250 140,200 180,150 Z" fill="#D2B48C" stroke="#8B4513" stroke-width="3" />
    
    <!-- Loaf Texture -->
    <path d="M200,150 C220,100 280,100 300,150 L320,200 C340,250 340,300 300,350 C280,370 220,370 200,350 L180,300 C140,250 140,200 180,150 Z" fill="url(#loafTexture)" />
    
    <!-- Loaf Shadow -->
    <ellipse cx="250" cy="380" rx="60" ry="15" fill="rgba(0,0,0,0.1)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Tagline -->
  <text x="300" y="500" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle" fill="#556B2F">Own your taste, own your site, own your future</text>
</svg>
